titulo: Microsoft is killing off the ‘Copilot Plus PC’ brand
cuerpo: Remember when Microsoft wanted everyone to know that "Copilot Plus PCs" were the ones to get, because those were the PCs that that'd have enough built-in AI muscle to get things done?
